objective: Perform 8-bit addition of two numbers and record both 8-bit sum and carry byte.
theory: When addition results in a sum > 255 (FFH), the Carry Flag (CY) becomes 1. The ADC or JNC instruction tracks the carry byte.
algorithm: 4. ADD B. If JNC SKIP is taken, skip incrementing C.
6. Store Sum at 2052H and Carry at 2053H.
assembly_code:
MVI C, 00H   ; Clear C (Carry)
LDA 2050H   ; Load 1st byte
MOV B, A    ; Move to B
LDA 2051H   ; Load 2nd byte
ADD B       ; Add B to A
JNC SKIP    ; Jump if no carry
INR C       ; Increment C if carry
SKIP: STA 2052H ; Store Sum
MOV A, C    ; Move Carry to A
STA 2053H   ; Store Carry
HLT
